title: Scheduling contract v1 (S7-S17; synthetic data only)

AvailabilityRequirement.description: One resource the window must occupy: a named resource, or any active resource of the kind at the location.

AvailabilitySearch.description: S9 query. Range is local dates in the location's zone, inclusive, at most 31 days (ADR 0009 S-S3-R3).

bufferMinutes.description: Free time required after the window on every required resource.

slotMinutes.description: Start granularity in real minutes from local midnight (default 15).

appointmentTypeCode.description: Recorded as a constraint; appointment-type rules are not modelled yet (see coverage).

advisory.description: A result is advisory; booking (S10) rechecks against the database constraint.

ResourceRefId.description: Opaque server-issued resource identifier. Never parse it.

TimeZone.description: IANA time zone name. The server also requires its zone database to know it.

Instant.description: RFC 3339 instant with an explicit offset; stored and returned in UTC.

TimeBlockReason.description: Proposed reason vocabulary for unavailable time (not a practice decision).

NoOperatoryReason.description: Reserved exception vocabulary for an appointment that holds no operatory (S7). Proposed; starts with the observed no-show and cancellation cases. Never modelled as a resource.

AppointmentOperatoryAssignment.description: Booking-side shape (consumed by S10): an appointment holds zero or one operatory; holding none requires a typed reason.

Cursor.description: Opaque, tenant-bound, HMAC-protected. Never parse it.

effectiveUntil.description: Exclusive; the next version's effectiveFrom, or null when open-ended.

PatientRef.description: Opaque patient reference (same pattern as patient.schema.json PatientRef).

ReasonCode.description: Server-checked reason enumeration value; never free text.

RequestOrigin.description: Server-set surface the request came through; never caller input.

ContactConsent.description: Contact-consent state as recorded on the request; the consent decision itself belongs to E.

AppointmentRequestCreate.description: S8 request. Holds no resource and blocks no slot. Needs preferredWindows or flexibility (422 preferenceRequired).

AppointmentRequestClose.description: Close with a reason. `scheduled` requires appointmentRef (422 otherwise) and links both records; `expired` requires the configured expiryPolicyRef.

data.description: Requests that reached a terminal state without a booking (at most 100 listed; count is the total).

AdditionalResources.description: Equipment or staff the appointment also occupies (provider and operatory are separate fields).

OverrideCode.description: Proposed override vocabulary (not a practice decision).

BookingOverride.description: Authorized override of overrideable conflicts only (policy booking-override.pending-approval.1: outside_availability). Needs scheduling.override; resource overlap is never overrideable.

CancelReason.description: Proposed cancellation vocabulary (not a practice decision).

BookingCreate.description: S10 booking. Success is BookingResult outcome booked (201); conflicts are 409 with detail.conflicts filtered by visibility; denials are 403/404.

AppointmentReschedule.description: Books the new window and records the original as rescheduled with links both ways, in one transaction.

BookingResult.description: The successful BookingResult outcomes. conflict and denied are typed refusals (Refusal schema, 409/403/404), never 2xx.

AppointmentStatus.description: Booking lifecycle only. Attendance, clinical completion and billing are separate facts.

AttendanceKind.description: AttendanceTransition kinds. Clinical completion (C5) and billing (B1) are not attendance kinds; cancelled and rescheduled are appended by the booking commands only.

AttendanceState.description: Derived from the transition sequence; never stored.

OwnedPlaceholder.description: A fact owned by another workstream; always null here until that workstream records it.

counts.description: Counts by booking status and derived attendance state; confirmedManual and confirmedAutomated are separate.

VisitItemRef.description: Opaque reference of one visit-context item (a pin, form assignment or lab-case link).

ProducerRecordRef.description: Opaque reference into the owning clinical producer (C8, C13, C16); never content.

VisitContextPin.description: S12 pin of the current medical-history version (C8). Empty body: the version comes from the producer.

created.description: false when the same form was already assigned to the appointment (the recorded assignment is returned).

resolution.description: Resolved through the producer at read time; a voided or missing record is reported, never omitted.

VisitContextSlot.description: One producer-bound item: explicitly unavailable (with owner and reason), or the resolved entries.

acceptsChanges.description: false once the booking is cancelled or rescheduled.

readiness.description: Unavailable items never count as checked: complete is true only when every producer is available and every entry resolves.

SeriesCreate.description: S13 series request (and plan query). Wall-clock times are in the location's zone (ADR 0009 S-S3-R1 month-end, S-S3-R2 daylight saving). count is at most the configuration ceiling 52; the per-request limit (default 26, scheduling.series.occurrenceLimit) is enforced by the domain and named in the refusal.

skipConflicts.description: Create only the conflict-free occurrences and enumerate the skipped ones (default false: atomic).

SeriesExtend.description: Explicit continuation: books the next block of occurrences after the last one (never silent).

openOccurrenceRefs.description: On end: the future occurrences still booked, for explicit reassignment or cancellation.

currentAppointmentRef.description: The standing booking after reschedules (the reschedule chain is followed).

WorkItem.description: Proposed shared exception-first work item (docs/PRACTICE-TIME-AND-AUTOMATION.md): reason, safe explanation, evidence, owner, due time, next action and who owes it. Owned by S until a shared module adopts it.

explanation.description: Server-authored, plain language; never caller text.

WorkCoverage.description: Whether the list could be computed: an unavailable list is never an empty one.

suppressionDecision.description: Typed placeholder: the decision is E6's; scheduling evaluates no consent and stores no reason of its own.

RequestedChannel.description: Stated preference only; whether contact is allowed is the E6 decision.

WaitlistAdd.description: S15 waitlist entry. Creates no appointment, hold or occupancy.

WaitlistOffer.description: Offer a window to one entry: a short-lived hold (ADR 0009 S-D6 pending) and a waitlist_offer intent with channel none. Never books.

OfferRespond.description: The explicit acceptance (books through the S10 insert path from the hold) or decline/withdrawal (releases the hold).

RecoveryExecute.description: Offer the freed slot to the named entry, or to the first prepared candidate. A service principal needs a live standing policy.

StandingPolicyGrant.description: Explicit, revocable standing authorization for one service principal to execute cancellation recovery offers in the named locations, within limits, until expiry (at most 90 days).

consent.description: Whether the patient may be contacted is the E6 decision; referenced, never evaluated here.
